items.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-07
items.content_text:
1. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN flaw exploited to bypass SAML MFA; CISA adds CVE-2026-19868 to KEV
2. WorkOS says AI hacking agent run by a researcher breached its internal sales application

5. US seeks extradition of three suspects in AI-assisted CEO-impersonation fraud over $100 million
6. Researchers report residential proxy services routing traffic through White House network addresses
7. Chainalysis breach exposed credentials and live tokens for all customers
8. DigiCert reports breach of business customer contact data through unauthorized internal account
9. Attacks hit European refrigeration controllers; US agencies publish hardening guidance
10. QNAP warns of in-the-wild Plex2Shell attacks on NAS devices running Plex Media Server

items.content_text:

items.content_text:
